content:
jess-sales: Hermes Capital wants a short POC (10 business days). Requirements: Okta IdP-initiated SAML, two ACS endpoints (web + batch callback), assertion must include `roles` claim and an audience for both `https://hermes.app/web` and `https://hermes.app/batch`. They also want domain lock (DNS TXT verification), SCIM group->role binding using a custom extension attribute, and notes on Hosted vs Dedicated pricing impacts. Can SE own config?

henry-se: I can. Quick clarifying q's: will they use Okta-provisioned SCIM full sync + deltas, or just delta events? Frequency? Also confirm batch ACS needs POST and supports RelayState.

jess-sales: Buyer answered: Okta will do full sync nightly + delta pushes during business hours (~every 3m) for ~250 users during POC. Batch ACS needs POST and RelayState; they want SAML to be consumable by a background job with separate audience.

meera-sec: Security checklist: need to confirm SAML cert rollover approach (we support dual certs for overlap), JWS signatures for assertion if requested, KMS/HSM options for Dedicated, envelope encryption details, and SCIM audit retention (Hosted default 90d). Also request DPA + SOC2 link to include in SOC pack.

infra-bot: POC env created: `poc-hermes-2026-01`. K8s namespace `poc-hermes`. Endpoint: https://poc.redwood.internal/hermes. Admin contact jess-sales@redwood.com.

jess-sales: Pricing Q from Hermes: will SCIM ops be billed? What is the token pricing delta if we move from Hosted to Dedicated reserved capacity? Any onboarding fees for domain verification?

tara-fin: SCIM control-plane ops are part of Hosted for small POCs (no separate charge). Token billing remains usage-based on Hosted; Dedicated gives a committed monthly spend with lower per-token effective rate. For example, a 12-month reserved capacity for their projected 2M tokens/day yields ~25-35% reduction depending on instance type. Onboarding/domain verification has no charge, DNS TXT check is part of standard onboarding.

henry-se: Implementation notes: we will map SCIM extension `urn:hm:params:scim:schemas:extension:1.0:roleMapping` -> `roles` claim in SAML/JWT. Example SCIM group payload they provided:

```json
{"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group","urn:hm:params:scim:schemas:extension:1.0:roleMapping"], "displayName": "fraud-team", "members": [{"value":"u-987","display":"aline@hermes.com"}], "urn:hm:params:scim:schemas:extension:1.0:roleMapping": {"redwood_role":"finance_admin","perm_list":["view_reports","approve_tx"]}}
```

henry-se: For SAML multi-audience we support multiple AudienceRestriction entries. Okta metadata must list both audiences or we'll configure two SP entries and consume the IdP-initiated SSO with an audience override. For background jobs, ensure ACS URL accepts POST and we will set a separate Audience URI for the batch process.

meera-sec: Action items for compliance pack and POC security:
- meera-sec: provide DPA + SOC2 links and cert rollover docs to Hermes
- henry-se: upload sample SP config and SCIM mapping guide to the POC workspace
- tara-fin: send a short cost comparison (Hosted v Dedicated) with example numbers for 2M tokens/day
- jess-sales: schedule kickoff call and add Hermes infra contact
Target kickoff: Tuesday 09:30 PT (in 48 hours). :calendar:

jess-sales: Thanks team — I'll follow up with Okta metadata and DNS TXT value request. DNS TXT example they should publish: `redwood-site-verification=hermes-poc-7f3b`

infra-bot: Note: temporary increased SCIM rate limits enabled for namespace for POC window. Monitor `/metrics/scim_syncs`.
